subject: Code to calculate delta_elpd and weights in model comparison

messages.author: c481bd0447c0caf2
messages.subject: Code to calculate delta_elpd and weights in model comparison
parts:
Hi,

In case anyone might find it useful, I've put together a function to calculate delta in elpds and SEs as well as model weights during model comparison. It works with objects created by loo() and waic(). The function is heavily inspired by the compare() function in Richard McElreath's rethinking package (and requires the package to calculate model weights). Also, I used a bunch of code from loo::compare().

Function code: https://gist.github.com/matthewgthomas/de54079a5b94163f60761aff214fe7af#file-compare_models_delta-r

Example:

library(rstanarm)

source("https://gist.githubusercontent.com/matthewgthomas/de54079a5b94163f60761aff214fe7af/raw/21203cd6b91e2b7723bbce831ee43540197b1fb1/compare_models_delta.r")

# fit some example models from https://cran.rstudio.com/web/packages/rstanarm/vignettes/continuous.html
data(kidiq)
post1 <- stan_glm(kid_score ~ mom_hs, data = kidiq, 
                  family = gaussian(link = "identity"), 
                  chains = 1)
post2 <- update(post1, formula = . ~ mom_iq)
post3 <- update(post1, formula = . ~ mom_hs + mom_iq)

# Compare them with loo
loo1 <- loo(post1)
loo2 <- loo(post2)
loo3 <- loo(post3)

compare_models_delta(loo1, loo2, loo3)
compare_models_delta(loo1, loo2)  # check it's ok with only two objects

# compare with waic
waic1 <- waic(post1)
waic2 <- waic(post2)
waic3 <- waic(post3)

compare_models_delta(waic1, waic2, waic3)
compare_models_delta(waic1, waic2)  # check it's ok with only two objects

Cheers,
Matt

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Re: Code to calculate delta_elpd and weights in model comparison
parts:
Hi Matthew,

There'e a reason why loo package doesn't give weights. The usual used way to compute them (and also how rethinking package computes them) gives weights which are too close to 0 and 1. We don't recommend using these weights. We have a draft paper describing better approach and experiments showing better results. We should get that paper in arXiv soonish, but it might still take couple weeks. After that, loo package will also return weights.

Aki
